title: Предлоги времени и места глубже + итог B1
summary: Разберёмся, где русские «в», «на», «к» и «до» превращаются в разные английские предлоги: during или while, by или until, on time или in time, in the picture и on the website, arrive at и arrive in, — а в конце соберём шпаргалку по всему уровню B1.

grammar.title: 1. Главная идея: предлог — это картинка, а не перевод
grammar.html:
Что вы уже знаете (уроки A1-14 и A2-15): at 8, on Monday, in April; in the box, on the table, at the bus stop; until, during, while. На B1 разбираем тонкие места. Главный секрет: не переводите русский предлог, а представьте картинку — точка, поверхность или «внутри».
КартинкаМестоВремя
at — точкаat the entrance, at the traffic lightsat 6 pm, at the weekend
on — поверхность, линияon the wall, on the coaston Friday, on my birthday
in — внутри, периодin the car, in Berlinin June, in the 90s
Русский

Встретимся у входа.

Кто это на фото?

Пришли макет до пятницы.

Я в офисе до семи.

В конце концов мы помирились.

English

Let's meet at the entrance.

Who's that in the photo?

Send the layout by Friday.

I'm at the office until seven.

In the end we made up.

Русское «на фото» — это картинка «внутри рамки», поэтому in the photo. А «до пятницы» бывает двух видов: «не позже» (by) и «всё время до» (until).

grammar.title: 2. Время: at, on, in — тонкости; on time или in time; at the end или in the end
grammar.html:
Базовое правило вы знаете. Теперь исключения и готовые пары, в которых путаются даже продвинутые.
ГоворимПример
at the moment, at present, at the same timeI'm busy at the moment.
at the weekend (брит.) · on the weekend (амер.)What are you doing at the weekend?
at Christmas, но on Christmas DayWe play board games at Christmas.
at night (вообще) · in the night (в одну ночь)I work better at night. · A noise woke me up in the night.
in the morning, но on Friday morningSee you on Sunday evening.

Без предлога перед next, last, this, every: See you next Friday. · We moved last June. А перед днём недели on часто просто опускают: See you Friday.

in + отрезок = «через» или «за»:

  • The stream starts in ten minutes. — Стрим начнётся через десять минут. (не after ten minutes)
  • I learned Figma in two weeks. — Я выучил Figma за две недели.
ПараСмыслПример
on timeточно по плану, не опоздавThe train left on time.
in time (for / to)успеть, заранееWill you be home in time for dinner?
at the end (of)в конце чего-тоat the end of the match
in the endв итоге, в конце концовIn the end we bought a PS5.
  • We got to the station just in time. — Успели в последний момент. (противоположность — too late)
  • At first I hated the new interface, but in the end I got used to it. — Сначала… но в итоге… (at first ↔ in the end)
  • I'm going on holiday at the beginning of August. — в начале августа (at the beginning ↔ at the end)
I'll call you after five minutes. · in the end of the month · on next Monday
I'll call you in five minutes. · at the end of the month · next Monday

grammar.title: 3. during, for, while; by, until, by the time
grammar.html:
during — когда (+ существительное). for — сколько длилось. while — пока (+ кто + глагол). until — всё время до. by — не позже.
СловоПосле негоПример
during — во времясуществительноеI fell asleep during the film.
for — в течениеотрезок времениI slept for two hours.
while — покакто + глаголI fell asleep while I was watching the film.
  • When did it happen? — During the tournament. How long did it last? — For three days.
  • It rained in the night. = It rained during the night. (с night, summer и т. п. можно и так, и так)
  • What will you do while you're waiting? — после while о будущем — настоящее время, не will

by или until? Спросите себя: действие длится до этого момента или должно случиться не позже?

until — длится доby — не позже
I'll be working until 7.I'll have finished by 7.
Let's wait until the update comes out.The update should come out by Monday.
Max is away until Friday.Max will be back by Friday.
  • I didn't get up until eleven. — Я встал только в одиннадцать. (not … until = «только в»)
  • Where's Anna? She should be here by now. — Она уже должна быть здесь.

by the time — «к тому времени, как»: пока шли, что-то уже случилось.

  • By the time we get to the shop, it will be closed. — будущее: by the time + настоящее время.
  • By the time I logged in, the raid had already started. — прошлое: + had done.
  • I got there at midnight, but by then everyone had left. — by then / by that time = «к тому моменту».
It rained during three days. · during I was sleeping · Send it until Friday.
It rained for three days. · while I was sleeping · Send it by Friday.

grammar.title: 4. Место: in, at, on — точка, поверхность, внутри
grammar.html:
Большинство случаев решает картинка. Но у некоторых слов предлог просто надо запомнить — особенно там, где русский говорит «на».
inaton
in the room, in the poolat the bus stop, at the dooron the floor, on the ceiling
in a queue, in a rowat the traffic lightson the left, on the right
in a photo, in a pictureat reception, at her deskon page 5, on a list, on a menu
in a book, in a newspaperat the top, at the bottomon a map, on a website
in the sky, in the worldat the end of the streeton the second floor
in the country (за городом)at the corner (улицы)on the coast, on a river
  • There were a lot of people in the shop. — внутри. Turn left at the shop. — у магазина как точки на маршруте.
  • There's water in the bottle and a label on the bottle. — вода внутри, этикетка на поверхности.
  • Someone is at the door. — стоит у двери. There's a note on the door. — висит на двери.
  • I like to sit in the front row. · She works in the marketing department.
  • You'll find the rules on our website. · Write your name at the top of the page.
  • Our office is on the third floor. · Sochi is on the coast. · I bought coffee on the way to work.
СловоКакПример
front / back машиныinThe kids sat in the back.
front / back зала, зданияatWe sat at the back of the cinema.
front / back листа, открыткиonWrite the date on the back of the card.
угол комнатыinThe PC is in the corner of the room.
угол улицыat / onThere's a café on the corner.
on the photo · on the sky · in the website · in the left · at the second floor
in the photo · in the sky · on the website · on the left · on the second floor

grammar.title: 5. Здания, события, города, транспорт; to, into, arrive, get
grammar.html:
at — место как «функция» или событие (на работе, на вечеринке, на вокзале). in — внутри здания, в городе. Движение «куда» — to, «внутрь» — into.
atin
at home, at work, at school, at universityin bed, in hospital, in prison
at a party, at a concert, at a conferencein Paris, in a small town
at the station, at the airportin the building (про само здание)
at Anna's, at the doctor'sIt's cold in Anna's flat.
  • I saw Oleg at a game conference last week. — событие → at.
  • We had dinner at the hotel. All the rooms in the hotel have a PS5. — где ужинали (at) / внутри здания (in).
  • I'll be home all evening. = I'll be at home all evening. Но: Let's eat at home.
  • Does this train stop at Tver? — город как точка на маршруте → at.

Транспорт: on a bus, on a train, on a plane, on a bike, но in a car, in a taxi. Сели «в» — get on the bus / get off the bus, но get into a taxi / get out of a taxi.

КудаКакПример
go, come, travel, return, a triptoWe're flying to Tokyo. · Welcome to our studio!
была (опыт)been toI've been to Japan twice.
arrive — город, странаinWe arrived in Berlin at night.
arrive — здание, событиеatWe arrived at the hotel at 2 am.
gettoWhat time did you get to the party?
homeбез предлогаI got home late.
внутрь / наружуinto / out ofShe walked into the room.
We arrived to Moscow. · I went to home. · Welcome in our team! · I was in the bus.
We arrived in Moscow. · I went home. · Welcome to our team! · I was on the bus.

grammar.title: 6. Устойчивые выражения: in the rain, on purpose, at the age of
grammar.html:
Эти сочетания не объясняются картинкой — их учат целиком, как одно слово. Хорошая новость: их немного, и они встречаются постоянно.
inonat
in the rain, in the sun, in the shade, in the darkon TV, on the radio, on the phoneat the age of 16 / at 16
in English, in dollarson fire, on purposeat 100 km an hour
in love (with), in a good / bad moodon the whole (в целом)at 100 degrees
in my opinionon holiday, on business, on a trip
on strike, on a diet
  • Don't sit in the sun — let's find a table in the shade. — Не сиди на солнце, найдём столик в тени.
  • How do you say "patch" in Russian? — Как по-русски «патч»?
  • You're in a good mood today! What happened? — Ты сегодня в хорошем настроении!
  • In my opinion, the first season was better. — По-моему, первый сезон был лучше.
  • I didn't delete your save on purpose, I promise! — Я не специально удалил твоё сохранение!
  • The project was hard, but on the whole I enjoyed it. — Было тяжело, но в целом понравилось.
  • My boss is away on business. · No trains today — the drivers are on strike.
  • She started coding at the age of twelve. · We were driving at 130 km an hour.

Можно и for a holiday, когда говорим, куда поехали: They've gone to Georgia for a holiday.

«Специально» — on purpose, «случайно» — by accident / by chance. «По-моему» — только in my opinion: русское «по» тут не помогает.
by my opinion · on English · I saw it in TV · at the rain
in my opinion · in English · I saw it on TV · in the rain

grammar.title: 7. Типичные ошибки — проверьте себя
grammar.html:
I'll be back after ten minutes.
I'll be back in ten minutes.
I'll see you on next Friday.
I'll see you next Friday.
We played during three hours.
We played for three hours.
Send me the file until Monday.
Send me the file by Monday.
in the end of the month
at the end of the month
Who's this on the photo?
Who's this in the photo?
We arrived to London at night.
We arrived in London at night.
What time did you get to home?
What time did you get home?
On my opinion, it's too long.
In my opinion, it's too long.
Итог юнита в одной строке
during + событие, for + срок, while + кто + глагол · until — длится до, by — не позже · on time — вовремя, in time — успеть · at the end of / in the end · in the photo, on the website, at the door · arrive in город, arrive at здание · go home.

grammar.title: 8. Итог B1 — шпаргалка по уровню
grammar.html:
Поздравляем: вы прошли весь уровень B1 и большую часть синего Мерфи! Вот всё, что вы теперь умеете, — с номерами уроков, чтобы быстро вернуться и повторить.

Времена

УрокТемаПример
b1-1Present Simple / Continuous, state verbs, alwaysYou're always interrupting me!
b1-2Past Simple / Continuous, used toI was coding when the power went off.
b1-3Present Perfect против Past SimpleI've lost my keys. I lost them on Monday.
b1-4have been doing; for / sinceI've been waiting for an hour.
b1-5Past Perfect (+ Continuous)The film had started when we arrived.

Будущее

УрокТемаПример
b1-6I'm meeting / going to / willI'm meeting Max at six. I'll call you.
b1-7will be doing, will have done; when I doBy June I'll have finished the course.

Модальные глаголы

УрокТемаПример
b1-8can, could, be able to; must / can't (догадки)She must have forgotten.
b1-9may, might; have to, mustn't, needn'tYou needn't bring anything.
b1-10should, had better, it's time; wouldYou'd better save the file.

If / wish, пассив, косвенная речь, вопросы

УрокТемаПример
b1-11if I do / if I did; I wish I knewIf I were you, I'd take it.
b1-12пассив во всех временахThe servers are being updated.
b1-13косвенная речьShe asked me where I lived.
b1-14вопросы, So do I, question tagsYou haven't seen it, have you?

-ing или to

УрокТемаПример
b1-15enjoy doing, decide to, want you toI want you to check it.
b1-16remember, try, need, like, would ratherRemember to save! I remember playing it.

Существительные, артикли, кванторы, придаточные

УрокТемаПример
b1-17исчисляемые, a / an и theI need some advice.
b1-18school или the school; названияShe's at university.
b1-19noun + noun, 's и of; myself; there и ita friend of mine
b1-20some, any, none, few, most, each, everyNone of us knew the answer.
b1-21who, that, which — и без нихThe game I told you about is on sale.

Прилагательные, сравнения, предлоги

УрокТемаПример
b1-22bored / boring, so / such, too / enoughIt was such a boring film.
b1-23сравнения, порядок слов, still / yet / evenThe more I play, the more I like it.
b1-24предлоги времени и местаSend it by Friday.
Самые важные «переключатели» B1
  1. Состояние или действие? know, like, want, belong — обычно без -ing: I know, не I'm knowing.
  2. Сколько длится до сейчас? → have been doing + for / since. Раньше другого прошлого → had done.
  3. Будущее в процессе / уже готово → will be doing / will have done. После when, if, until, by the time — без will.
  4. Догадка о прошлом → must / can't / might + have done.
  5. Нереальное сейчас → if I had…, I'd…; I wish I knew — без would после if и wish.
  6. Спрятанный вопрос и косвенная речь → порядок утверждения: She asked where I lived.
  7. После глагола → проверьте: -ing (enjoy, finish) или to (decide, want)? remember / try / stop меняют смысл.
Весь B1 в одной строке
Вы умеете точно показывать время (have been doing, had done, will have done), строить догадки и советы (must have, should, had better), фантазировать (if I were, I wish), пересказывать чужие слова, выбирать между -ing и to, артиклями, кванторами и предлогами. Дальше — B2: те же темы на уровне нюансов, фразовые глаголы и сложные связки.

texts.title: The wedding on the coast
texts.text:
My cousin Alina got married last summer in a small town on the coast, and I almost missed it.

The plan was simple. The ceremony started at four on Saturday. My train was at 8:15, so I would be there by two: in time for lunch, a shower and a short rest in the shade. I had even printed the schedule. I hardly ever do that.

At first, everything went well. I got to the station early, found the right platform and bought a coffee. Then a voice announced that the train drivers were on strike until midday. No trains. Not delayed: cancelled.

There was a long queue at the information desk. While I was standing in it, I called Alina. She was in a terrible mood. “You promised to be here on time!” she said, and hung up. Meanwhile, the queue hardly moved.

By the time I reached the front, all the buses to the coast were full. In the end, a woman who was standing behind me offered to share a taxi. She was going to the same destination. On the way I found out that she was going to the same wedding, too. She was the groom's aunt.

We spent four hours in the back of a small car with our luggage on our knees. During the journey she told me every family story she knew. In my opinion, I now know the groom better than Alina does.

We arrived at twenty to four. There was no time to change, so I went straight to the entrance of the hall and sat in the last row, still in my travel clothes. The music started a few minutes later. Alina saw me from the front and smiled. I was in time. Just.

On the whole, it was a lovely day. Flowers were hanging from the ceiling, and there was a table in the corner just for desserts. But the best moment came during the speeches. The groom's aunt stood up and told everyone how she had “found a lost cousin in a queue”. Everybody laughed.

Later Alina asked me if I had arrived at the last minute on purpose, for the story. I said no. I'm not sure she believed me.

questions.q: Why were there no trains in the morning?
Who was the woman in the queue?
Where did the author sit during the ceremony?

texts.title: The banner is too tall
texts.text:
Irina: Anton, where are you? The conference opens at nine and our stand is still empty.
Anton: I'm in a taxi. There's a delay on the bridge. I'll be there by half past eight.
Irina: You said that about the report last week. The deadline was Monday. I got it on Wednesday.
Anton: That was different. The report was long. The bridge is short.
Irina: Very funny. Have you got the banner?
Anton: It's in the boot with the rest of the luggage. Where exactly is our stand?
Irina: Hall B, in the corner, next to the coffee machine. Come in through the main entrance and go past reception.
Anton: Next to the coffee machine? Perfect. People will queue right in front of us.
Irina: That's the idea. Meanwhile, I'll put the brochures out. How tall is the banner, by the way?
Anton: Three metres. Why?
Irina: The ceiling here is two and a half.
Anton: Oh. Well, we can fold the top. Nobody reads the top anyway.
Irina: The top is our logo, Anton.
Anton: Then we fold the bottom. Our phone number is on the website.
Irina: Fine. Another thing. I've got an appointment with a journalist at eleven. Can you stay at the stand until lunch?
Anton: Sure. During lunch I'm going to the talk in Hall A. I want a seat in the front row this time.
Irina: Last year you got there just in time and sat on the stairs.
Anton: The stairs are the best seats. Nobody asks you questions there.
Irina: Where are you now?
Anton: Still on the bridge. The driver says it's going to be at least twenty minutes.
Irina: Anton!
Anton: Don't worry. On the whole, I'm never late. I'm just not often on time.
Irina: That's the same thing.
Anton: Not in my opinion. See you at half past eight. Or nine. Keep me a coffee.

o: In Hall A, near the stairs
In Hall B, in the corner, next to the coffee machine

test.q: I ___ this series since Monday, and yesterday I ___ five episodes.
test.why: С понедельника до сейчас → have been doing (b1-4); вчера → Past Simple (b1-3).

test.q: By the time we arrived, the concert ___. (already / start)
test.why: Раньше другого момента в прошлом → had + V3 (b1-5); by the time (b1-24).

test.q: Don't call me at 8 — I ___ my stream then. (do)
test.why: В процессе в момент будущего → will be doing (b1-7).

test.q: Somebody ___ my coffee — the cup is empty!
test.why: Уверенная догадка о прошлом → must have + V3 (b1-8).

test.q: I'd buy that monitor if it ___ so expensive. (not / be)
test.why: На самом деле дорого → если бы: if + прошедшая форма (b1-11).

test.q: The servers ___ right now, so the game is offline. (update)
test.why: Пассив в процессе сейчас → are being + V3 (b1-12).
Косвенный вопрос → порядок утверждения и сдвиг времени: where I lived (b1-13, b1-14).

test.q: I'll never forget ___ my first game. And please don't forget ___ the tickets!
test.why: forget doing — о воспоминании, forget to do — о том, что нужно сделать (b1-16).

test.q: She's ___ university now, and ___ of her friends study design too.
test.why: at university без the (b1-18, b1-24); most of her friends (b1-20).

test.q: This is the ___ game ___ I've ever played.
test.why: Самый + ever → the best (b1-23); после существительного — that / which, не what (b1-21).

test.q: The film was so ___ that I fell asleep ___ it.
test.why: Фильм вызывает скуку → boring (b1-22); во время + существительное → during (b1-24).

walk.title: Предлог — это картинка, а не перевод

steps.text: Вы уже знаете (A1 и A2): at 8, on Monday, in April; in the box, on the table, at the bus stop. За каждым из трёх слов стоит своя картинка — и для места, и для времени.
Хотите сказать «Кто это на фото?». Русское «на» тянет к on, но фото — это рамка, а люди внутри неё. Поэтому in the photo. Не переводите «на» — представьте картинку.

steps.why: Тот, кто изображён, — внутри рамки → in the picture.

steps.text: Итог: at — точка, on — поверхность, in — внутри. Сначала картинка, потом слово.

walk.title: Время: at the moment, next Friday, in ten minutes

steps.text: Базовое правило вы знаете. А вот готовые пары, где путаются даже продвинутые: at the moment (сейчас), at night, at Christmas — но in the morning и on Friday morning (утро конкретного дня).
rows: at the moment, at night, at the weekend, at Christmas
in the morning, in the evening
on Friday morning, on Sunday evening, on Christmas Day
ex: I’m busy at the moment.
Я сейчас занят.
See you on Sunday evening.
Увидимся в воскресенье вечером.
steps.tip: at the weekend (брит.) = on the weekend (амер.) — оба верны. at night — ночью вообще, in the night — в одну конкретную ночь.

steps.text: Перед next, last, this, every предлога нет совсем. Русское «в следующую пятницу» так и тянет сказать on — но не нужно.
ex: See you next Friday.
Увидимся в следующую пятницу.
We moved last June.
Мы переехали в июне прошлого года.
I play every evening.
Я играю каждый вечер.

steps.why: Перед last (и next, this, every) предлог не ставим.

steps.text: «Стрим начнётся через десять минут» — это in ten minutes, а не after. И «выучил за две недели» — тоже in.
ex: The stream starts in ten minutes.
Стрим начнётся через десять минут.
I learned Figma in two weeks.
Я выучил Figma за две недели.
steps.bad: I’ll call you after five minutes.

steps.why: «Через» столько-то от сейчас → in ten minutes.

steps.text: Итог: несколько готовых пар учим целиком. Перед next / last — пусто. «Через» — in.
Русское «вовремя» — два разных выражения. on time — точно по плану, по расписанию, без опозданий.
ex: The flight left on time.
Рейс вылетел вовремя.
The meeting is at 10. Please be on time.
Встреча в 10. Пожалуйста, не опаздывайте.

steps.text: in time — «успеть», с запасом до какого-то момента: in time for dinner, in time to see the start. just in time — в последний момент.
ex: Will you be home in time for dinner?
Ты успеешь домой к ужину?
We got to the station just in time.
Мы успели на вокзал в последний момент.
steps.tip: on time — «по часам» (как в расписании). in time — «успел до того, как стало поздно» (противоположность — too late).

steps.q: The train left ___ time, at 9:15 exactly, as planned.
steps.ru: Поезд ушёл вовремя, ровно в 9:15, по расписанию.
steps.why: Точно по плану, по расписанию → on time.

steps.q: We got to the cinema just ___ time to see the start.
steps.ru: Мы успели в кино в последний момент — к самому началу.
steps.why: «Успели», в последний момент → just in time.

steps.text: «В конце» — тоже два. at the end of — в конце чего-то (месяца, матча). in the end — «в итоге, в конце концов», пара к at first (сначала).
ex: The deadline is at the end of the month.
Дедлайн в конце месяца.
At first I hated the new interface, but in the end I got used to it.
Сначала я ненавидел новый интерфейс, но в итоге привык.
steps.bad: in the end of the month
steps.tip: Начало — тоже at: at the beginning of August (в начале августа).

steps.q: We argued for an hour, but ___ we chose the blue logo.
steps.ru: Мы спорили час, но в итоге выбрали синий логотип.
steps.why: «В итоге, в конце концов» → in the end.

steps.text: Итог: две пары, которые по-русски звучат одинаково.
rows: at the end of… / in the end

walk.title: «Во время», «до пятницы», «к тому времени» — during, until, by

steps.text: Вы уже знаете из A2: during + событие (когда?), for + отрезок (сколько?), while + кто + действие. На B1 главное — не путать их в спешке.
steps.bad: It rained during three days. / during I was sleeping
steps.good: It rained for three days. / while I was sleeping

steps.q: I got a call ___ I was driving.
steps.ru: Мне позвонили, пока я был за рулём.
steps.why: Дальше кто + действие (I was driving) → while.

steps.text: Русское «до пятницы» бывает двух видов. Действие длится до момента — until. Должно случиться не позже момента — by (к).
rows: Max will be back by Friday.
steps.tip: not… until = «только в»: I didn’t get up until eleven — Я встал только в одиннадцать.

steps.q: Send me the file ___ Monday — not later.
steps.ru: Пришли мне файл к понедельнику, не позже.
steps.why: Не позже определённого дня → by. until — только когда что-то длится.

steps.text: by the time — «к тому времени, как». Про будущее — дальше настоящее время (как после when). Про прошлое — часто had done: что-то уже случилось раньше.
ex: By the time we get to the shop, it will be closed.
Когда мы доберёмся до магазина, он уже закроется.
By the time I logged in, the raid had already started.
К тому времени, как я зашёл, рейд уже начался.
steps.tip: by then — «к тому моменту»: …but by then everyone had left. by now — «уже сейчас»: She should be here by now.

steps.q: By the time we got to the conference, the first talk ___.
steps.ru: Когда мы добрались до конференции, первый доклад (talk) уже закончился.
steps.why: Закончился раньше, чем мы приехали (в прошлом) → had finished.

steps.text: Итог: спросите себя — длится или «не позже»?
rows: не позже: send it by Friday
к тому времени, как: …it had started

walk.title: Место: in the photo, on the website, at the top

steps.text: Одно и то же место меняет предлог, когда меняется картинка. Стоит у двери — at, записка висит на двери — on. Вода внутри бутылки — in.
ex: Someone is at the door.
Кто-то у двери.
There’s a note on the door.
На двери записка.
There were a lot of people in the shop.
В магазине было много людей.

steps.text: Где русский говорит «на», английский часто думает иначе. «На фото, в небе» — in. «На сайте, на странице, в меню, в списке, на карте» — on. «Вверху, внизу» — at the top / bottom.
rows: in the photo, in the sky, in a book, in a queue, in the front row
on the website, on page 5, on the menu, on a list, on a map
at the top, at the bottom, at reception, at the end of the street

steps.q: You’ll find the schedule ___ our website.
steps.ru: Расписание вы найдёте на нашем сайте.

steps.text: Ещё три частых места с on: on the left / right (слева / справа), on the second floor (на втором этаже), on the coast (на побережье). И по дороге — on the way.
ex: Our office is on the third floor.
Наш офис на третьем этаже.
The buttons were on the left.
Кнопки были слева.
I bought coffee on the way to work.
Я купил кофе по дороге на работу.
steps.bad: in the left / at the second floor

steps.q: The meeting room is ___ the second floor.

steps.text: front / back и corner зависят от картинки. Машина — in the back. Зал, здание — at the back. Лист, открытка — on the back. Угол комнаты — in the corner, угол улицы — on / at the corner.
ex: We sat at the back of the cinema.
Мы сидели в конце зала кинотеатра.
The PC is in the corner of the room.
Компьютер в углу комнаты.
There’s a café on the corner.
На углу есть кафе.

steps.text: Итог: не переводите «на» — смотрите, что это за место.
rows: in the photo, in the sky, in a queue
on the website, on the left, on the second floor
at the door, at the top, at reception

steps.text: at — место как занятие или событие: at work, at university, at a party, at a conference, at the station, at Anna’s (у Ани). in — внутри здания или в городе: in the building, in Paris.
ex: I met her at a conference in Berlin.
Я познакомился с ней на конференции в Берлине.
We had dinner at the hotel. All the rooms in the hotel have a PS5.
Мы ужинали в отеле. Во всех номерах отеля есть PS5.
steps.tip: Помните школу из b1-18: at university, in hospital, in bed — без the.

steps.q: I saw Kate ___ a concert on Saturday.
steps.ru: Я видел Кейт на концерте в субботу.

steps.text: Транспорт: автобус, поезд, самолёт, велосипед — on (on a bus, on a train). Машина и такси — in. Садимся так же: get on / off the bus, но get into / out of a taxi.
rows: on a bus, on a train, on a plane, on a bike
in a car, in a taxi
get on / off the bus, get into / out of a taxi

steps.q: Скажите: «Я был в автобусе, когда ты позвонил»
o: I was in bus when you called.
I was on the bus when you called.
I was at the bus when you called.
steps.why: Автобус, поезд, самолёт → on the bus.

steps.text: «Куда» — to: go to, fly to, welcome to. arrive — никогда не to: город → arrive in, здание или событие → arrive at. get → get to. А home — без предлога.
rows: We arrived in Berlin at night.
We arrived at the hotel at 2 am.
What time did you get to the party? I got home late.
steps.bad: We arrived to Moscow. / Welcome in our team!
steps.good: We arrived in Moscow. / Welcome to our team!

steps.q: What time did you arrive ___ the airport?
steps.ru: Во сколько ты приехал в аэропорт?
steps.why: arrive + здание → at. arrive to не бывает.

steps.text: Итог: at — событие или «функция» места, in — внутри и в городе. Куда — to, приехать — arrive in / at.
rows: at work, at a party, at the station
on the bus / in a taxi
go to Berlin, arrive in Berlin, arrive at the hotel, go home

steps.text: Эти сочетания картинкой не объяснить — их учат целиком, как одно слово. С in: in the rain, in the sun, in the shade (в тени), in English, in a good mood, in my opinion (по-моему).
ex: Let’s find a table in the shade.
Давай найдём столик в тени.
How do you say “patch” in Russian?
Как по-русски «патч»?
In my opinion, the first season was better.
По-моему, первый сезон был лучше.

steps.text: С on: on TV, on the phone, on purpose (специально), on the whole (в целом), on holiday, on business (по работе), on strike (бастуют). «Случайно» — by accident.
ex: I didn’t delete your save on purpose, I promise!
Я не специально удалил твоё сохранение, честно!
My boss is away on business.
Начальник в командировке.
On the whole, it was a good year.
В целом год был хороший.

steps.q: Sorry! I didn’t do it ___ purpose.
steps.ru: Прости! Я сделал это не специально.
steps.why: «Специально» → on purpose. by — только в by accident.

o: On my opinion, the ending is too long.
In my opinion, the ending is too long.
By my opinion, the ending is too long.

steps.text: Итог: три коробки готовых блоков. С at — ещё возраст и скорость: She started coding at 12 (в 12 лет).
rows: in the rain, in English, in a good mood, in my opinion
on TV, on purpose, on the whole, on holiday
at the age of 12, at 100 km an hour

walk.title: Итог B1: что вы теперь можете сказать

steps.text: Вы прошли весь уровень B1. Это не список правил — это фразы, которые вы теперь можете сказать сами. Сначала — время, очень точно.
rows: I’ve been waiting for an hour.
When we arrived, the film had started.
By June I’ll have finished the course.

steps.text: Догадки, советы и фантазии: что наверняка случилось, что лучше сделать и что было бы, если…
rows: If I were you, I’d take it. I wish I knew.

steps.ru: Она не ответила. Наверно, она уснула.
steps.why: Догадка о прошлом → must have + третья форма (b1-8).

steps.text: Пересказ, вежливые вопросы и длинные фразы: чужие слова, «спрятанный» вопрос, пояснение через who / that.
rows: She asked me where I lived.
You haven’t seen it, have you?
The game I told you about is on sale.

steps.why: Пересказ после told → время сдвигается назад: is → was (b1-13).

steps.text: И тонкая настройка: -ing или to после слова-действия, some / none / most, so / such, сравнения — и предлоги из этого урока.
ex: I enjoy working here, but I’ve decided to leave.
Мне нравится здесь работать, но я решил уйти.
None of us knew the answer.
Никто из нас не знал ответа.
Send it by Friday — we’re meeting at the entrance.
Пришли к пятнице — встречаемся у входа.

steps.text: Итог B1: вы умеете точно показывать время, строить догадки и советы, фантазировать, пересказывать и выбирать нужную форму. Дальше — B2: те же темы на уровне нюансов.
rows: have been doing, had done, will have done
must have done, should, if I were, I wish
-ing / to, by / until, in / on / at
